content: व्रज् I. €1 <ab>P.</ab> (व्रजति) .²1 To go, walk, proceed; नाविनीतैर्व्रजेद् धुर्यैः <ls>Ms. 4. 67</ls>. .²2 To go to, approach, visit; मामेकं शरणं व्रज <ls>Bg. 18. 66</ls>. .²3 To depart, retire, withdraw. .²4 To pass away (as time); इयं व्रजति यामिनी त्यज नरेन्द्र निद्रारसम् <ls>Vikr. 11. 74</ls>. .²5 To attain to, go to the state of. .²6 To obtain, gain. --II. €10 <ab>U.</ab> (व्राजयति-ते) .²1 To go. .²2 To prepare, decorate. (This root is used much in the same way as गम् or या <ab>q. v.</ab>)
